title: com.reconcile arguments (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0073; the estate owner as caller, DEC-0081)
description: outcome_unknown to completed or failed_known, observed only. Estate, caller Project, principal and session come from the authenticated endpoint and are never accepted here: an unknown field is refused (invalid_arguments). The caller is the current responder, or the estate owner when no responder holds the request's slot (DEC-0081); the caller's role is taken from the endpoint too, so the same arguments serve both.

request.description: A request in outcome_unknown. Called by a responder: a request of the caller's Project, for a capability whose current slot the caller holds. Called by the estate owner (the trusted operator principal, verified by the host, that owns the request's target Project; in an organization estate that member only; no Project grant makes one): a request whose (Project, capability) slot no responder holds, absent or lapsed with no current enrollment; while a responder holds it, or for any other operator, the call is refused not_authorized (DEC-0081).

digest.description: The request's semantic digest; another one is digest_conflict.

observed.description: Reconciliation settles an unknown outcome only by an observed result.

summary.description: What the caller observed. Optional for a responder; required for the estate owner, whose settlement without it is refused observation_required and leaves the request outcome_unknown (DEC-0081). The schema cannot see the caller, so FAC-SEM-109 checks it on the transition record.
